definition.name: General: Active Organizations Count
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM organization WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true)

definition.name: General: Active Users Count
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM user_account WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true)

definition.name: General: New Users This Month
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM user_account WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

definition.name: General: Recent User Logins
definition.sql: SELECT id, user_name, email, status, last_login FROM user_account WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) LIMIT 10

definition.name: General: User Presence Status
definition.sql: SELECT COALESCE(status, 'offline') AS status, COUNT(*)::bigint AS user_count FROM user_account WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY status

definition.name: General: Active Teams Count
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM team WHERE (is_deleted IS FALSE OR is_deleted IS NULL) AND (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true)

definition.name: General: System Teams Overview
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, description, created_at FROM team WHERE (is_deleted IS FALSE OR is_deleted IS NULL) AND (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) LIMIT 10

definition.name: Active Dashboards
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, dashboard_type, lifecycle_status, visibility, owner_id, is_template FROM attome_dashboard WHERE is_active = true

definition.name: Inactive Dashboards
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, dashboard_type, lifecycle_status, visibility, owner_id, is_template FROM attome_dashboard WHERE is_active = false

definition.name: Template Gallery
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, name_ar, description, dashboard_type, thumbnail, template_category, template_version, row_version, created_at, modified_at FROM attome_dashboard WHERE is_template = true AND (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true)
